description: Lookup exceptions: corrections to the generator's *_id -> <resource>_output lookups for this provider version. lookups is keyed by resource type ("*" = every resource), then argument. An entry states only what differs and inherits the "*" entry, which inherits the default (suffix-matched resource, read id, matched by name). Fields: resource, attribute (read instead of id), format (one %s, e.g. /subscriptions/%s), by ("name" or "key"), lookup (false = plain input), path (nested block, e.g. custom_parameters; only when the entry is limited to that block), note. Merged: this file -> settings repo copy -> manifest Module.resource_mapping.

identity_ids.note: identity.identity_ids is always user-assigned identity IDs: looked up by identity_names.

role_definition_id.note: Role assignment-style arguments want the role definition's full resource ID. azurerm_role_definition.id is '<resource id>|<scope>', which is rejected; role_definition_resource_id is the ARM ID. Applies to pim_active/pim_eligible_role_assignment and role_management_policy (no validator on these; per provider docs).

subscription_id.note: Most subscription_id arguments are a bare UUID (validator): automation_connection_*, iothub_endpoint_*, sentinel_data_connector_*, data_share_dataset_blob_storage, monitor_action_group, *_connection authentication (no validator). azurerm_subscription.id is the alias path, not the subscription.
